d:
The Rockets defeated the Jazz, 125-118 tonight in Houston. Alperen Sengun contributed a team-high 43 points to go with 12 rebounds and 5 assists, with Kevin Durant of the Rockets adding an additional 22 points (5-14 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Darryn Peterson finished with a team-high 28 points along with 7 rebounds for the Jazz in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 10-3 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-12 for the season.
